name: line-diff
description: Presentation-quality line-by-line diff between two text blobs (before/after), returning a list of same/add/remove lines suitable for a side-by-side or unified review view. Uses a bounded LCS algorithm that falls back to a linear prefix/suffix diff on very large inputs (over 250k LCS cells or 4000 total lines) instead of allocating an unbounded matrix, and caps the rendered output at 4000 lines with a note when a diff is larger than that. Not a patch/merge tool — output is for review display only.
